name: Minced meat in a leaf
summary: Thái minced pork with scallion, garlic, chili, mắc khén, and pepper, wrapped in a leaf and grilled. One account beats the mince with egg and also allows dong leaf.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 1 April 2022, 4 September 2020, and 16 July 2026.
howToEat: With sticky rice or plain rice, on the 16 July 2026 account. That account prints about 120,000–150,000 VND a plate at a Chiềng Cơi kitchen.
where: Phường Chiềng Cơi, on the 16 July 2026 price. The 2020 and 2022 accounts do not name a ward.
priceBand: Báo Sơn La, 16 July 2026, prints about 120,000–150,000 VND a plate at a Chiềng Cơi kitchen. A market price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nhua pinh in Son La — minced meat grilled in a leaf
seoDescription: Nhứa pỉnh in Sơn La. One Báo Sơn La account uses pork and banana leaf. Another beats the mince with egg and allows dong leaf. A Chiềng Cơi plate is about 120,000–150,000 VND.
